intro x t ht

      HasDerivAt (fun r => (ubar u q) (x, r) k)
        (velocity (ubar u q) x t k) t :=
    h_T003.1.2.2.2.1 x t ht k
  have hs : HasDerivAt
      (fun r => ∑ k : Fin m, (ubar u q) (x, r) k * (ubar u q) (x, r) k)
      (∑ k : Fin m, (velocity (ubar u q) x t k * (ubar u q) (x, t) k +
        (ubar u q) (x, t) k * velocity (ubar u q) x t k)) t := by
    exact HasDerivAt.fun_sum (fun k _ => (hd k).mul (hd k))
  have heq :
      (fun r => ∑ k : Fin m, (ubar u q) (x, r) k * (ubar u q) (x, r) k)
        =ᶠ[𝓝 t] (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) := by
    filter_upwards [eventually_gt_nhds ht] with r hr
    exact h_H004 x r hr
  have hz : HasDerivAt
      (fun r => ∑ k : Fin m, (ubar u q) (x, r) k * (ubar u q) (x, r) k)
      0 t :=
    (hasDerivAt_const t (1 : ℝ)).congr_of_eventuallyEq heq
  have hsum := hs.unique hz
  have htwo : 2 * dot ((ubar u q) (x, t)) (velocity (ubar u q) x t) = 0 := by
    dsimp [dot]
    rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    convert hsum using 1
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro k hk
    ring
  have hdot : dot ((ubar u q) (x, t)) (velocity (ubar u q) x t) = 0 := by
    linarith
  refine ⟨hdot, ?_⟩
  simpa only [dot, mul_comm] using hdot

T008 : ∀ (n m : ℕ) (u : Space n × ↑(Set.Ioi 0) → Value m) (q : Value m),
  UnitValued (ubar u q) →
    (FirstCalculus (ubar u q) ∧
        SecondCalculus (ubar u q) ∧
          ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p => density (ubar u q) p.1 p.2) {p | 0 < p.2} ∧
            ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p => densityRate (ubar u q) p.1 p.2) {p | 0 < p.2} ∧
              (∀ (x : Space n) (t : ℝ),
                  0 < t → HasDerivAt (fun r => density (ubar u q) x r) (densityRate (ubar u q) x t) t) ∧
                (∀ (j : Fin n) (x : Space n) (t : ℝ),
                    0 < t →
                      ∀ (k : Fin m),
                        (fderiv ℝ (fun y => ubar u q (y, t) k) x) (Pi.single j 1) = spatial (ubar u q) j x t k ∧
                          (fderiv ℝ (fun y => velocity (ubar u q) y t k) x) (Pi.single j 1) = mixed (ubar u q) j x t k ∧
                            (fderiv ℝ (fun y => spatial (ubar u q) j y t k) x) (Pi.single j 1) =
                              spatialSecond (ubar u q) j x t k) ∧
                  (∀ (x : Space n) (t : ↑(Set.Ioi 0)), ubar u q (x, ↑t) = u (x, t)) ∧
                    ∀ (x : Space n), ∀ t ≤ 0, ubar u q (x, t) = q) →
      ∀ (x : Space n) (t : ℝ),
        0 < t →
          dot (ubar u q (x, t)) (velocity (ubar u q) x t) = 0 ∧ dot (velocity (ubar u q) x t) (ubar u q (x, t)) = 0
